payload.title: 10 Seminyak Wedding Venues for Beachside Vows
payload.audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a budget of AUD 150k or more, often with parents contributing, who have chosen Bali and want a beach-facing wedding with a social, design-led feel close to restaurants and nightlife rather than a remote clifftop. They need to compare Seminyak's beachfront resorts, villas and beach clubs on the same terms (setting, ceremony options, capacity, rooms, exclusive use) and know which questions to ask before they commit.
payload.goal: Speak with a Wedded Advisor: request a Wedded Concierge consultation so an advisor can check ceremony options and house rules for the couple's shortlisted Seminyak venues on their dates and guest count.
payload.angle: Every venue here passes one test on its own official site, read live: it hosts weddings, and it is called beachside only where the venue's own words place it by the beach. Seminyak lists mix resorts, private villas and beach clubs as if they were the same product. This guide covers the whole strip (Petitenget, Batu Belig, Seminyak, Double Six and Legian), gives each venue identical fields (setting, ceremony options, capacity, rooms, exclusive use or 'Not published', who it suits, one standout), and separates the three venue types so a couple can see what changes between a beachfront resort, a villa with exclusive use and a beach club before they shortlist. No ranking.
must_include: Intro with a direct answer in the first 100 words: Seminyak's beach strip runs from Petitenget and Batu Belig through Seminyak to Double Six and Legian, and venues split into beachfront resorts, private villas and beach clubs; link /destination-weddings/bali-wedding-venues prominently (draft; reciprocal link) and /destinations/asia/bali once.

Near the top: an at-a-glance table (venue, area on the strip, venue type, setting, ceremony options) and a guest-count grid (venue against published capacity bands, 'Not published' where not stated). Mobile friendly.

Inclusion rule stated in the copy plainly (without research talk) and applied to every entry: only venues whose own official site, read live, says they host weddings; 'beachside' only where the venue's own words place it by the beach; private villas only with an official wedding page and exclusive use; beach clubs only where their own site states private weddings. Target 10; if fewer qualify the title count changes and the person is told; reserves fill gaps; no padding.

10 venue entries, same fields in the same order: setting (rewritten from the venue's own description); ceremony options as stated; capacity, rooms and exclusive use where published, else 'Not published'; a 'Suits' line; one standout. Venue names only. No ranking or rank-implying numbering.

How to compare like for like: venue type, ceremony on site, seated capacity, rooms on site, exclusive use. Carries the ONLY Advisor line in the body (brand-facts wording: the Advisor confirms inclusions in writing before the couple commits) and a link to /wonderland-concierge. Questions to ask each venue on money and contracts (deposits, cancellation, what is included, in writing), access (beach access, public beach use, wet-weather backup, noise and music curfews), insurance timing (when to take out travel and wedding cover relative to deposits), security and privacy (public beach frontage, guest-only areas, neighbouring beach clubs).
Choosing between a beachfront resort, a villa and a beach club: what each type typically means for guest rooms, exclusive use, privacy and atmosphere, framed as questions, not promises.

Getting there and when to marry: Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) and Smartraveller Indonesia facts only; wet and dry season wording as Smartraveller states it; hazards as stated; no 'best month'; transfers framed as questions for the venue, never arrangements.

Legal in brief: Australian Embassy Jakarta and Smartraveller facts dated once as at November 2026; check requirements with the embassy and Indonesian authorities; never imply venues or the Wedded Advisor handle legal paperwork; nothing on same-sex legal position. Link /expert-advice/indonesian-wedding-traditions once (culture aside, not as a legal source).

FAQ (4 to 6): Can you get married on the beach in Seminyak? Which Seminyak venues offer exclusive use? How many guests can a Seminyak venue hold? Do beach clubs host private weddings? Can Australians legally marry in Bali?

Close: shortlist with a Wedded Advisor (brand-facts claims only). Links /wonderland-concierge (anchor names 'Wedded Concierge') and /magazine as the magnet. UTMs utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=seminyak-wedding-venues&utm_content=primary|secondary|magnet|closing.
avoid: Any price, fee, minimum spend or amount; any capacity, room count, distance or drive time not on an official source.
'Best', ranking language or rank-implying numbering; 'best month' or 'best time'.
Calling a venue beachside, beachfront or on the sand unless its own words say so; settings inferred from photos or snippets.
Research talk in copy ('on its own site', 'we could not confirm', 'does not publish' as our search); per-line source credits; hedge stacking.

Names other than venues (no planners, florists, photographers, transfer companies, villa agencies); venue contact or business details (deferred); transfer arrangements or availability promises; implied partnerships or preferred rates.
Same-sex marriage legal position; implying venues or the Advisor handle legal or civil registration paperwork; religious ceremony requirements.
Wedded Privileges; Advisor claims beyond brand-facts.md; more than one Advisor line in the body besides the close; 'last dance'; 'Wonderland Concierge' as anchor text.
Competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking or review sites, social media or Wikipedia as sources; competitor wording or images (Easy Weddings included).
Clichés (paradise, fairytale, dream day, breathtaking), party-scene hype, exclamation marks, keywords pasted in headings, em dashes, US spelling.
AI images of any venue, destination or wedding; images other than placeholders until licensed or press kit with permission.
payload.cannibalisation_check: No existing page targets 'seminyak wedding venues'. The draft /destination-weddings/bali-wedding-venues targets 'bali wedding venues' island-wide and lists only a few Seminyak venues (Oberoi, Legian, reserves Alila and W); this post is the area deep dive and links it prominently, and that draft should link back from its Seminyak section. Where a venue appears in both, keep wording distinct. Hub /destinations/asia/bali covers the destination broadly. SEO to confirm rankings for 'seminyak wedding venues' and variants (seminyak beach wedding, wedding venues seminyak bali, petitenget wedding).
